summary: Avis Budget Group filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 reporting receipt of a $650 million cash settlement from Pentwater Capital Management and affiliates under a June 19, 2026 Settlement and Release Agreement resolving the company's Section 16(b) short-swing profits lawsuit. The court approved the payment, which will be recorded in Q4 financials. Avis expects to use part of the proceeds to repay the remaining $350 million principal of its 5.750% Senior Notes due 2027 before year-end. The filing states nothing constitutes a redemption notice; watch redemption mechanics and any residual use of proceeds.
